values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackriver ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Black River State Forest Campground: nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in access to the Black River.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackriver ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well') + amenity table (Boat ramp(R) OR carry-in access(C): C), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackriver ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 12 sites 'available for tents, small trailers and large trailers'. No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackriver ('There are 12 sites available for tents, small trailers and large trailers', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (12 campsites), read 2026-10-25. The stored 40-ft maximum is on neither DNR page; the only source found is a directory (campgroundviews.com 'most of which can accommodate 40-ft vehicle/trailer'), so it is cleared.

note: Secluded rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the Black River, 8 mi NE of Naubinway via US-2 and Black River/Peters Creek Rd; popular in spring and fall for steelhead and salmon runs. Peters Creek Pathway hiking nearby. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 12 sites for tents/small/large trailers, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed); season open all year, roads not plowed (already manual, matches); phone 906-643-8620 (Straits SP) matches.
